parameters.question: Compare rMATS A3SS.MATS.JC.txt outputs: records must match on chromosome, positions (longExon/shortES/shortEE/flanking coordinates), strand, and per-sample junction counts (IJC/SJC); PSI (IncLevel) values within +/-0.01; PValue and FDR within +/-0.01; column order and row order may differ; ID column may differ.

Compare rMATS A5SS.MATS.JC.txt alternative 5' splice site event tables. Match events by gene ID, chromosome, strand and exon coordinates (longExonStart/End, shortES/EE, flankingES/EE) rather than by the arbitrary event ID or row order. Then check that the junction counts (IJC/SJC per sample), IncLevel values, PValue/FDR and IncLevelDifference agree within minor numeric tolerance.

Compare rMATS skipped-exon (SE.MATS.JC.txt) outputs from sample_1.bam vs sample_2.bam. Match events by gene ID and exon coordinates (exonStart_0base, exonEnd, upstream/downstream exon coordinates, strand, chr), not by the arbitrary event ID. Junction counts (IJC/SJC), IncLevels, IncLevelDifference, PValue and FDR should agree within small numeric tolerance. Row and column order may differ.
